capacity_model.kind: planning sensitivity; not a validated population forecast

favourable.backup_and_restore: Separate volumes required; conservatively reserve another total_working_gib each. Export may require uncompressed object bytes, not pack bytes.

central.backup_and_restore: Separate volumes required; conservatively reserve another total_working_gib each. Export may require uncompressed object bytes, not pack bytes.

prudent.backup_and_restore: Separate volumes required; conservatively reserve another total_working_gib each. Export may require uncompressed object bytes, not pack bytes.

sampling_limits.chapter_count_not_measured: Filename matches are not chapter counts; fff_chapter classes need adapter inspection.

A.wal_directory_post_stop_note: A includes subsequent isolated-schema recovery checks; B/C pipeline only. Not a retained WAL peak.

B.wal_directory_post_stop_note: A includes subsequent isolated-schema recovery checks; B/C pipeline only. Not a retained WAL peak.

C.wal_directory_post_stop_note: A includes subsequent isolated-schema recovery checks; B/C pipeline only. Not a retained WAL peak.

limitations: No prolonged OpenSearch outage or recovery under large backlog measured in P5
Heterogeneous sample inspected but not ingested
Capacity scenarios are sensitivity assumptions, not measured population cardinalities
Only source-concurrency comparison on the same smallest ZIP; no global optimum established

recovery_tests.disk_pressure: injected capacity probe; no destructive filesystem test
recovery_tests.outage: unreachable search URL, not a prolonged service outage

readers.condition: Post-drain, authenticated search and sample reader; internal HTTP

preflight.mode: static read-only; mandatory manual runtime and restore checks unresolved

memory-3g-rejected.message: [Errno 12] ZIP central directory exceeds validated memory/quota envelope

pool.note: Last sample before SIGKILL may omit up to five seconds; includes connection setup.

sustained.search_unavailable_seconds_scope: Canonical window only; excludes the additional hold and service startup.

capacity.method: Source-compressed weighted PackStore and search; member-weighted PostgreSQL. Min/main/max observed EPUB strata; TXT/HTML own coefficients. Metadata rowid upper bounds, no filename identity inference. Favorable metadata reuses current projections; central/prudent treat every metadata record as a new derived identity. 25% operational margin; maintenance covers one largest-component rewrite, not concurrent full rewrites. Not statistical intervals.

diagnostic_notes: Original full controller JSON was overwritten by an isolated CSV verifier failure after the complete aggregate had been saved. Raw interval/resource logs, immutable verification files and the preexisting completion-summary.json retain the measured results. CSV verifier omitted object kind in readMany; fixed, then reran verification only. No canonical data was changed by this failure.

csv_supplement.note: 64 complete CSV rows reserialized from a bounded 2 MiB prefix; original whole-member CRC not verified. Separate test database, all objects and derived ID/generations verified, queues drained. Pack/row size enters the minor-format sensitivity; projection costs use an explicitly declared SQLite proxy.

mandatory_manual_checks: Supply and review the definitive Compose environment and component capacity plan.
preflight_actual.reason: Invalid or unavailable configuration; output suppressed to protect secrets
